set.body:
Source: review of composition currently living in the unpublished examples module.

Problem:
users must assemble many low-level resources manually; LocalOpaque.runtime takes eight positional arguments and there is no stable published entry point.

Acceptance:
- Add resource-safe published facades equivalent to SlurmLocal.default(...), Slurm.overSsh(...), and ManagedController.durable(...).
- Use validated configuration records and named defaults rather than long positional constructors.
- Preserve access to low-level algebras/interpreters for advanced composition.
- Demonstrate local opaque, SSH opaque, durable recovery, logs, and typed task use in compile-checked five-line-scale examples.
set.title: P6f.17: Publish ergonomic local, SSH, and durable facades
